answer.rationale: Negotiate the expiring incumbent contract using the low-cost quote as the benchmark, preserving delivery continuity while pursuing the mandated savings. A primary-vendor switch with the line at 94% volume and no buffer creates unverified delivery risk; memory_c2 establishes cost and onboarding performance but not supply reliability. Verify memory_c4 because it is the most directly relevant evidence that incumbent benchmarking can improve both price and payment terms. It remains uncertain whether negotiation can achieve the full 18% reduction.
